definitions.explanation: Connected to or part of a larger organization, product, or institution. Common in school names ({付属|ふぞく}{小学校|しょうがっこう}) and product accessories ({付属品|ふぞくひん}).

examples.japanese: {付属|ふぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーブル→ケーブル：04432_keeburu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{付属|ふぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My son attends a middle school affiliated with a university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{付属|ふぞく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The manual comes with the box, so please check it.

notes:
The more common modern spelling of ⟦{附属|ふぞく}→附属：00050_fuzoku⟧; the two are interchangeable in meaning. Used both as a noun-modifier (X{付属|ふぞく}Y = Y attached to X) and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb meaning 'to be attached to / come with'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{付属|ふぞく}⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: university-affiliated hospital
- ⟦{付属品|ふぞくひん}→付属品：18630_fuzokuhin⟧: accessories, included parts
- {付属|ふぞく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: is attached / comes included
- {付属|ふぞく}⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧: attached documents

WRITING:
In educational and institutional names (e.g. {筑波大学|つくばだいがく}⟦{附属|ふぞく}→附属：00050_fuzoku⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧), the older form ⟦{附属|ふぞく}→附属：00050_fuzoku⟧ is still standard. In everyday writing about product accessories, {付属|ふぞく} dominates.
